titulo: One Nation senator says parents who support their trans children are engaging in ‘child abuse’
cuerpo: ‘There’s male, there’s female, and then there’s mental illness,’ Tyron Whitten says on YouTube show Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast One Nation senator Tyron Whitten has claimed parents supporting their children who identify as transgender are engaging in “child abuse”, telling a fringe YouTube show: “there’s male, there’s female, and then there’s mental illness”. Guardian Australia has unearthed several incendiary comments from Whitten and fellow One Nation senators Pauline Hanson and her longtime lieutenant Malcolm Roberts, about transgender Australians.
